Name: Harvest With an Axe
Author: NoNameKz
Description:
[b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ffff][size=6][u]Features:[/u][/size][/color][/font][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][b]Harvest with Axe:[/b] Allows you to use any grade of axe to harvest multiple trees, twigs, saplings, and stumps within a diamond radius. By holding the [b]right mouse button[/b], the radius will be displayed. Then, hold the [b]left mouse button[/b] to trigger chopping within that radius. [b]For controller users[/b], the [b]X button[/b] will display the diamond radius, and the [b]A button[/b] will chop down the trees.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Configurable UI:[/b] Adds a user interface to toggle which objects can be chopped. Additionally, it includes an option to set the animation delay.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][color=#ff7700][b]Note[/b]:[/color] [/size][i][size=3]Currently, it doesn't support cutting large stumps, large logs, or fences.
[/size]
[/i]
[b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=6][u]Compatibility:[/u][/size][/color][/font][/b]
[size=3]This mod is compatible with most other mods and has been successfully used alongside with [b]popular mod[/b] such as [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b], [b]Ridgeside Village[/b], [b]East Scarp[/b], along with popular collections like[b] Stardew Valley Very Expanded[/b], [b]Aesthetic Valley Fairycore[/b], and [b]Aesthetic Valley Witchcore[/b], totaling over [b]200+ mods[/b]!

It also works seamlessly with the [b]latest version[/b] of Stardew Valley 1.6[/size]


[b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]My Other Mods:[/u][/size][/color][/font][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28721]Dynamic Combat[/url][/b]: Move freely while attacking, blocking, or unleashing special attacks—no more stiff movements! Attack from any angle with ease; you'll never have to turn your character again. It's a fun mod![/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28950]No More Lag[/url]﻿: Eliminate lag in heavily modded Stardew Valley - Struggling with slow load times or performance dips? This mod improves gameplay by optimizing asset preloading and memory management, ensuring smoother transitions and reduced lag during play![/size]
[/list]
